WITH m AS (
  SELECT zoneref, facetregistry,
    (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric / ((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric * power((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric, 2)) * 1000 AS mcr,
    (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric AS res,
    (mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::numeric AS geo
  FROM mesh
), a AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel,
    COUNT(m.facetregistry) AS total_meshes,
    COUNT(m.facetregistry) FILTER (WHERE m.mcr > 5.0 AND m.res < 1.0 AND m.geo < 0.5) AS hf_meshes,
    AVG(m.mcr) AS avg_mcr, AVG(m.res) AS avg_res, AVG(m.geo) AS avg_geo
  FROM sites s LEFT JOIN m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel
)
SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code, zonelabel AS site_name, total_meshes, hf_meshes,
  ROUND(hf_meshes * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_meshes, 0), 2) AS hf_percentage,
  ROUND(avg_mcr, 2) AS avg_mcr, ROUND(avg_res, 2) AS avg_resolution_mm, ROUND(avg_geo, 2) AS avg_geometric_accuracy_mm,
  CASE WHEN hf_meshes > 0 THEN 'Has High-Fidelity Meshes'
       WHEN total_meshes > 0 THEN 'Standard Mesh Quality'
       ELSE 'No Mesh Data' END AS mesh_quality_classification
FROM a
ORDER BY hf_percentage DESC NULLS LAST

WITH r AS (
  SELECT r.logregistry, r.arcref,
    (r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric AS acc,
    (r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric AS err,
    r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Method' AS method,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric AS res
  FROM registration r
  JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = r.arcref AND p.crewref = r.crewref
), x AS (
  SELECT *, res / (acc * sqrt(1 + err/acc)) AS rar FROM r
)
SELECT logregistry AS registration_id, arcref AS project_id,
  acc AS registration_accuracy_mm, err AS error_value_mm,
  ROUND(rar, 2) AS rar,
  CASE WHEN rar > 1.5 AND method LIKE '%Target%' THEN 'High Confidence'
       WHEN rar BETWEEN 1.0 AND 1.5 THEN 'Medium Confidence'
       ELSE 'Low Confidence' END AS confidence_level
FROM x
ORDER BY rar DESC NULLS LAST
note: Scan resolution comes from pointcloud matched on (arcref, crewref); registrations without a matching point cloud are dropped. Ordered by RAR descending.

WITH e AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
    100 - 2.5*abs((ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric - 20)
        - power(abs(((ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric - 50)/2), 1.5)
        - 600/((ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric + 100) AS esi
  FROM environment
)
SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.zonelabel AS site_name, ROUND(AVG(e.esi), 2) AS avg_esi
FROM sites s JOIN e ON e.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel
ORDER BY avg_esi DESC

SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.zonelabel AS site_name,
  c.structstate AS structural_state, s.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' AS preservation_status,
  CASE WHEN ((s.site_status->>'Pres_Stat') LIKE '%Poor%' OR (s.site_status->>'Pres_Stat') LIKE '%Critical%')
        AND c.structstate NOT LIKE '%Stable%'
       THEN 'Degradation Risk Zone' ELSE 'Not in Risk Zone' END AS risk_zone_category
FROM sites s JOIN conservation c ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
note: Includes all site/conservation rows with their category (not only risk-zone rows); structural state taken from conservation.structstate.

WITH b AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric AS res,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::numeric AS pd,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric AS cov,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::numeric AS lap,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::numeric AS noise,
    (r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric AS acc,
    (r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric AS err,
    (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric AS faces,
    (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric AS verts,
    (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric AS mres,
    (m.mesh_specs->>'Tex_Pix')::numeric AS tex,
    (m.mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::numeric AS geo
  FROM scans s
  JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = s.arcref AND p.crewref = s.crewref
  JOIN registration r ON r.arcref = s.arcref AND r.crewref = s.crewref
  JOIN mesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneref
), c1 AS (
  SELECT *,
    log(res * 1000) / log(pd) * 5 AS sri,
    cov * (1 + lap / 100 * (1 - cov / 100)) AS sce,
    faces / (verts * power(mres, 2)) * 1000 AS mcr,
    tex / (sqrt(faces) * mres) * 0.01 AS tdi,
    res / (acc * sqrt(1 + err / acc)) AS rar
  FROM b
), c2 AS (
  SELECT *,
    power(10 / sri, 1.5) * (sce / 100) * power(1 - noise / 30, 2) AS sqs,
    mcr * (tdi / 10) * (1 + exp(-geo)) AS mfs
  FROM c1
), c3 AS (
  SELECT *, sqs * 0.4 + mfs * 0.4 + sce * 0.2 - 5 * sqrt(noise / 10) AS adc FROM c2
), d AS (
  SELECT zoneref, 0.3 * adc + 0.3 * mfs + 0.2 * rar + 0.2 * sce - 2 * sqrt(err / res) AS dpq FROM c3
)
SELECT st.zoneregistry AS site_code, st.zonelabel AS site_name, ROUND(AVG(d.dpq), 2) AS dpq
FROM sites st JOIN d ON d.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
GROUP BY st.zoneregistry, st.zonelabel
ORDER BY dpq DESC
note: Row-level DPQ over scans+pointcloud+registration (arcref,crewref) + mesh (site), averaged per site.

WITH pc AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::numeric / NULLIF((p.cloud_metrics->>'Cloud_Dense')::numeric * (sp.spatial_dims->>'Area_M2')::numeric, 0) AS pcdr,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cloud_Dense')::numeric AS cd
  FROM scans s
  JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = s.arcref AND p.crewref = s.crewref
  JOIN spatial sp ON sp.arcref = s.arcref AND sp.crewref = s.crewref
), x AS (
  SELECT st.zoneregistry, pc.pcdr,
    ((f.feature_analysis->>'Trait_Count')::numeric + (f.feature_analysis->>'Arti_Count')::numeric)
      / NULLIF(pc.pcdr * sqrt(pc.cd), 0) * 1000 AS fee
  FROM sites st
  LEFT JOIN pc ON pc.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
  LEFT JOIN features f ON f.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
)
SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code, ROUND(AVG(pcdr), 2) AS avg_pcdr, ROUND(AVG(fee), 2) AS avg_fee
FROM x
GROUP BY zoneregistry
ORDER BY avg_fee DESC NULLS LAST

WITH w AS (
  SELECT pr.flowregistry,
    CASE WHEN lower(pr.flowsoft) IN ('agi.', 'agi', 'agisoft', 'agisoft metashape', 'metashape') THEN 'Agisoft'
         WHEN lower(pr.flowsoft) IN ('c.c.', 'cc', 'cloud compare', 'cloudcompare') THEN 'CloudCompare'
         WHEN lower(pr.flowsoft) IN ('geo.', 'geo', 'geomagic', 'geomagic studio') THEN 'Geomagic'
         WHEN lower(pr.flowsoft) IN ('r.c.', 'rc', 'reality capture', 'realitycapture') THEN 'RealityCapture'
         ELSE NULLIF(pr.flowsoft, '') END AS software,
    pr.flowstage AS stage,
    (pr.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric AS hrs,
    (pr.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric AS cpu,
    (pr.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric AS gpu,
    split_part(s.size, ' ', 1)::numeric AS size_gb,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::numeric AS pts
  FROM processing pr
  JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = pr.zoneref
  JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = s.arcref AND p.crewref = s.crewref
), x AS (
  SELECT *, size_gb * log(pts) / NULLIF(hrs * (cpu + gpu) / 200, 0) AS per FROM w
), g AS (
  SELECT software, stage, AVG(hrs) hrs, AVG(cpu) cpu, AVG(gpu) gpu, AVG(size_gb) size_gb, AVG(per) per,
         COUNT(*) AS workflow_count
  FROM x GROUP BY software, stage
)
SELECT software, stage,
  ROUND(hrs, 1) AS avg_processing_hours, ROUND(cpu, 1) AS avg_cpu_usage, ROUND(gpu, 1) AS avg_gpu_usage,
  ROUND(size_gb, 1) AS avg_data_size_gb, ROUND(per, 1) AS avg_per,
  CASE WHEN per < 0.5 THEN 'Bottleneck Detected' ELSE 'Efficient' END AS efficiency_status,
  workflow_count
FROM g
ORDER BY CASE WHEN per < 0.5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, per ASC
note: Software names normalized from noisy variants (e.g. AGI/Agi./agisoft metashape -> Agisoft); blank software kept as NULL group.

WITH e AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
    (ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric AS temp,
    (ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric AS hum,
    (ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric AS lux,
    100 - 2.5*abs((ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric - 20)
        - power(abs(((ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric - 50)/2), 1.5)
        - 600/((ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric + 100) AS esi
  FROM environment
), a AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel, AVG(temp) t, AVG(hum) h, AVG(lux) l, AVG(esi) esi
  FROM sites s JOIN e ON e.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel
)
SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code, zonelabel AS site_name,
  ROUND(t, 1) AS avg_temperature, ROUND(h, 1) AS avg_humidity, ROUND(l, 1) AS avg_illumination,
  ROUND(esi, 1) AS avg_esi,
  NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY esi) AS esi_quartile,
  CASE WHEN esi > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
       WHEN esi >= 70 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
       WHEN esi >= 50 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
       ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions' END AS environmental_condition
FROM a
ORDER BY esi DESC

WITH m AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric AS res,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::numeric AS pd,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric AS cov,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::numeric AS lap,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::numeric AS noise
  FROM scans s JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = s.arcref AND p.crewref = s.crewref
), q AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
    power(10 / (log(res*1000)/log(pd)*5), 1.5) * (cov*(1+lap/100*(1-cov/100))/100) * power(1-noise/30, 2) AS sqs
  FROM m
)
SELECT st.zoneregistry AS site_code, st.zonelabel AS site_name, ROUND(AVG(q.sqs), 2) AS avg_sqs
FROM sites st JOIN q ON q.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
GROUP BY st.zoneregistry, st.zonelabel
ORDER BY avg_sqs DESC

WITH w AS (
  SELECT e.equipregistry,
    (pr.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric AS hrs,
    (pr.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric AS cpu,
    (pr.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric AS gpu,
    split_part(s.size, ' ', 1)::numeric AS size_gb,
    (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric AS verts
  FROM equipment e
  LEFT JOIN processing pr ON pr.equipref = e.equipregistry
  LEFT JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = pr.zoneref
  LEFT JOIN mesh m ON m.zoneref = pr.zoneref AND m.equipref = pr.equipref
), x AS (
  SELECT *, hrs * (cpu + gpu) / 2 / NULLIF(size_gb * 10 * log(verts + 10000), 0) AS pru FROM w
), g AS (
  SELECT equipregistry, AVG(pru) AS pru, AVG(hrs) AS hrs, AVG(cpu) AS cpu, AVG(gpu) AS gpu
  FROM x GROUP BY equipregistry
)
SELECT equipregistry AS equipment_id,
  ROUND(pru, 2) AS pru,
  ROUND(hrs, 2) AS avg_processing_hours,
  CASE WHEN pru IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pru ASC NULLS LAST) END AS efficiency_rank,
  CASE WHEN pru < 5.0 THEN 'Optimized'
       WHEN pru <= 10.0 THEN 'Acceptable'
       WHEN pru > 10.0 THEN 'Needs Optimization'
       ELSE 'Unknown' END AS workflow_efficiency_status,
  jsonb_build_object('cpu_usage', ROUND(cpu, 2), 'gpu_usage', ROUND(gpu, 2), 'processing_hours', ROUND(hrs, 2)) AS resource_details
FROM g
ORDER BY pru ASC NULLS LAST
